Day Master page · dev build · golden chart, 庚 The Blade

The Day Master journey, painted

All 30 paintings are in at F2 xieyi, three per stem. The real screens below walk the journey from the album to an energy page, and show how each painting is set into its card.

  • Only the ink landsEach painting is multiplied onto the card after its paper is lifted to white, so the card's own paper shows through.
  • No rectanglesEvery edge is masked into the paper. No painting sits in a frame.
  • Text shares the paperLabels and lines start in the paintings' empty space instead of below a picture.
  • Three placementsD1 opens its card, D2 stands beside the text, D3 closes its card.

Card mode, with the stage

No screen leaves more than 40% bare. Under every card the stem's stage fills the foot of the screen: a minimal level-distance shanshui in the manner of Ni Zan and Ma Yuan, with a thin band of few strokes, pale ink and mist, and the rest left as paper (留白). It is toned like the house background plates. Top row: 庚 The Blade, three sheaves and a bare tree. Bottom row: 乙 The Vine, a low wall under vines.

01

Album

Tap the Archetype chip

The album hero carries the type and its four chips. The Archetype chip is the door into the Day Master page.

02

Card 1 · You are

The plate and the manifesto

The page opens as six cards, or one scroll. Card 1 keeps the painted stem plate. Under every card the stem's minimal stage landscape fills the foot of the screen, so a short card stands on its own ground instead of bare paper.

03

Card 2 · The sign

D1 bleeds off the top

The 16:9 painting runs to the card's top and side edges and fades out downward. The label and the first line of text begin inside its fading foot, so picture and text read as one surface.

04

Card 3 · Your nature

D2 is a column the text flows around

The 4:5 painting floats off the card's right edge, its left and bottom edges dissolving. The inscription and the portrait wrap around it, like a poem written beside a hanging scroll, and run full width below it.

05

Card 4 · Through your five energies

The pair frames, still waiting

Shown here: the lead and the first rows. Each energy row keeps its quiet 3:2 frame for the 25 pair paintings (the N1 brief, not painted yet). The whole row opens the energy page, with the arrow on its title line.

06

Card 5 · How your edge is built

D3 closes the card

The square painting rises out of the bottom-right corner under the last line, fading at its top and left. It is the card's full stop.

07

Card 6 · Your type

The doors out

The type line and three doors: How am I running, Who completes your chart, Replay your first reading.

08

Energy page

A row opens the full page

From the Day Master page an energy row goes straight to the full energy page (N2 A: the deeper the page, the deeper the tap).
